content.short: ether.fi is a decentralized liquid restaking protocol where users maintain control of their keys and staked assets.
content.description: ether.fi is a leading decentralized liquid restaking protocol on Ethereum that prioritizes user sovereignty and security. It stands out by being the first protocol to allow stakers to retain control of their private keys throughout the process, ensuring a non-custodial experience. By integrating with EigenLayer, ether.fi enables users to earn staking rewards while participating in the restaking economy through its eETH token. The architecture is built for resilience, providing robust infrastructure for institutional and retail participants looking for security and liquidity.
